system.description:
Myrgha Inheritance: a business. Rare, Earth. No item slots.

Prerequisites: You work for a Myrgha Oligarch

Your Oligarch has granted you with unique Prospector rights due to your family’s good services, allowing you to send expeditions to search for resources.

Survey (Action): As a Long Rest Action, roll 1D20. For every Long Rest Action you use on this roll, gain 1X Advantage. If you roll a nat20, you find a vein of natural resources. Then, roll 1D6 and consult the table below:
1: Your Oligarch thanks you, and takes the resources. Gain 1 Influence with your Oligarch and 1,000gp.
2-5: You get rich from your find. Gain 10,000gp immediately
6: You find an enormous vein of resources that affect your Civilization for centuries to come. Add 1 new resource type randomly from the City Building rules of Myths of Sacadia (if relevant to your game). Then, gain 10,000gp and 1 Influence from your Oligarch.

Rulebook p.32.
